target_customer: Consumers, especially younger users, who want direct answers instead of ad-filled search results; later a paid search API for AI developers
problem: Web search is cluttered with ads and SEO spam and tracks users. Andi gives conversational, sourced answers that are ad-free and privacy focused.
business_model: Free consumer search with planned paid pro and enterprise subscriptions; later a search API for agents and apps
product_category: Generative AI search engine and search API

founders.name: Angela Hoover
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch in September 2022 states she was 24; not recorded as age at founding.

founders.name: Jed White
education: University of Sydney (computer science, part time)
previous_startups: A popular start page with 3 million users
A media search and personalization startup
founders.background_notes: Former editor-in-chief of an Australian computer magazine per the YC page.

competitors.name: Google
competitors.traction_then: Over 90 percent global search share for most of the previous decade

technical_complexity.rationale: Combining semantic search, language models and live data into a fast answer interface was doable for a two person team using existing models, but ranking quality and an own index were hard.

defensibility.rationale: Answer-engine features were copyable by funded rivals; the only moat claimed is later work on its own index.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: After ChatGPT launched in late 2022, Bing, Google and Perplexity shipped answer-style search, crowding the wedge; no acquisition of Andi found.

market_need_then: Complaints about ad-heavy, spammy search and privacy were widespread in 2022; the TechCrunch article reported about 5,000 users and a demand for ad-free alternatives.

branding.domain_note: Uses AndiAI.com for the company and andisearch.com for the app.

identity.visual_style: Visual result cards in feed, grid and list views
identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly, like chatting with a smart friend

branding.brand_signature: Positioned as a smart friend that gives answers instead of links

brand_strength.rationale: Press covered the product but no source shows brand-driven growth, mascot or community; the name is short and friendly but sits in a crowded AI search field.

pivots.to: Search API for AI agents and apps built on its own index
pivots.why: Not stated; the company site now describes real-time web search for agents and apps

outcome_analysis: Andi raised about $2.5M from YC and angels, got press in 2022 and 2023, and reached roughly 400,000 monthly users around 2024 per MediaPost. Larger rivals copied generative answers after ChatGPT, and the company's current site presents a search API for agents, suggesting a turn toward developers. It remains active.
notes: The $2.5M is described as raised to date and includes a family and friends round and an angel round reported near $500,000; stage is not stated by the source so it is recorded as other. Aggregators list $2.6M or $3.11M, unverified. Competitor sources are dated September 2022, six months after the batch. Pivot date not sourced.
